scope: all tracked files via git archive; no .git, cache or local configuration

local_patches.summary: Adds Agent.run_interactive(): the existing drive/step loop as a generator that yields InteractiveToolRequest for externally executed tools and resumes on send(); the single-call dispatch site yields instead of executing, and a native batch containing a page action is refused as a batch. External tools are excluded from record replay, the drift threshold, repeated-result stop, input-error withdrawal and post-tool nudges. Per-advance run scope install/remove; no new thread, worker or event loop. Ordinary Agent.run and in-process tools are unchanged.
